meta.name: app-store-optimization
meta.description: Improves visibility and conversion in the App Store and Google Play — metadata, keywords, screenshots, ratings, and the listing experience that turns an impression into an install. Use this to audit or optimize an app listing, plan a launch listing, diagnose poor install conversion, or improve store search visibility.

copy.tagline: 提高应用在商店搜索中的曝光和下载转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在运营一款移动应用,希望让商店页面带来更多下载。
copy.tagline_en: Improve your app's store search visibility and install conversion rate.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a mobile app and want more downloads from a better store listing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能帮你在App Store和Google Play上优化应用列表：先诊断问题是搜不到还是看到了不安装，再针对标题、关键词、截图、评分、评论回复等给出具体建议。
howto.when: 当你想审计或优化应用商店列表、规划新应用上架、或诊断安装转化和搜索可见性问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这款App的App Store列表，先判断是搜不到还是转化差。
say.note: Claude会分步检查可见性和转化相关字段。

say.text: 我想在Google Play上架新应用，怎么定标题和关键词？
say.note: Claude会按商店索引规则给出建议。

say.text: 我的应用安装转化率低，截图和评分要怎么改进？
say.note: Claude会针对首屏截图与评分策略给建议。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude helps optimize app listings on the App Store and Google Play: it diagnoses whether the problem is being found or being installed, then gives specific advice on title, keywords, screenshots, ratings, review replies, etc.
howto.when_en: When you ask to audit or optimize an app store listing, plan a new launch listing, or diagnose install-conversion or search-visibility issues, this skill activates.

say_en.text: Audit this app's App Store listing and tell me what's wrong.
say_en.note: Claude checks visibility and conversion factors.

say_en.text: I'm launching on Google Play — how should I set title and keywords?
say_en.note: Advice follows each store's indexing rules.

say_en.text: My install conversion is low; how do I improve screenshots and ratings?
say_en.note: Focus on first screenshots and review prompts.
